title_zh: School life — 第23节可背诵讲义
body_en: School life is more than tests. Greet teachers, help classmates, and keep your desk tidy. When a lesson is hard, ask one clear question. Join one club and practice for ten minutes a day. A calm morning plan makes the whole day easier.
body_zh: 学校生活不只是考试。向老师问好，帮助同学，保持课桌整齐。课很难时，问一个清楚的问题。加入一个社团，每天练十分钟。平静的早晨计划会让整天更轻松。
